items.name: Main pier roof height above apron
items.method: (a) NAIP west-side dark band (oblique WNW facade + shadow) 8.5-9 m wide = (0.873 k + 0.122) h with k = 0.42 -> 17.4-18.4 m (minus any roof overhang); (b) NAIP roof centre vs SFO Museum footprint centre 5.85 m = 0.873 k h -> 15.9 m
items.note: +-2.5 m. Consistent with a three-level pier (apron + two passenger levels) [inf]. OSM says 25 m (unsourced)

corrected.reason: the overhang cancels in the band method; the footprint-offset method is unreliable; re-measured band gives 17.4-18.3 m

verification.evidence: west band re-measured 8.79 m (IQR [8.71, 8.86], 11 clean stations) = (relief + shadow) x h; a roof overhang moves both band edges equally and cancels, so the note's "minus any roof overhang" does not apply; method (b) depends on the SFO Museum footprint (offset 3-6 m at G). h = 18.3 m (k(x)) / 17.4 m (frame model).

verification.evidence: rim bands at the three pod apexes [2.49, 2.52, 2.49] m (note: 2.5-3); the dark band includes the pod's own shadow (0.116 per m), so the rise is [[4.9, 5.2, 6.8], [5.0, 5.2, 6.9], [4.9, 5.2, 6.8]] m (frame / k(x) / band without shadow) -> pod top 22.3-25.2 m, not 7.5 m above the main roof; the DOF 85 ft (25.9 m) point lies at pod 1's NNE end near the west eave (+-6.1 m).
